skill.name: subagent-driven-development
skill.description: Coordinates fresh implementation subagents and two-stage reviews for independent tasks in an existing development plan.
skill.summary: Execute independent plan tasks with dedicated implementers, specification checks, and code quality reviews.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: All 25 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown fences, file references, review questions, and a quoted configuration path. The skill does direct implementers to modify, test, and commit code, creating an operational risk that requires scoped permissions and approval.

remediation.issue: Implementer subagents are instructed to modify code and create commits without an explicit user approval checkpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before commits, constrain work to the stated repository, and prohibit destructive commands unless the user approves them.

content.value_statement: Complex implementation plans can lose quality when one agent carries every task. This skill assigns fresh implementers and staged reviewers to keep work aligned.
actual_capabilities: Extracts tasks and context from an existing implementation plan.
Dispatches a fresh implementation subagent for each independent task.
Prompts implementers to clarify requirements, test changes, self-review, commit, and report results.
Runs specification compliance review before code quality review.
Returns review findings to the implementer and repeats review until approval.
Requests a final review across the complete implementation.
limitations: Requires an existing implementation plan with mostly independent tasks.
Depends on compatible subagent, task tracking, review, and branch completion tools.
Implementation agents can modify files, run commands, and create commits.
Multiple agents and repeated reviews increase execution time and token usage.

use_cases.title: Deliver Planned Features
use_cases.description: Execute a prepared feature plan while checking each task against requirements and quality standards.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Repository Changes
use_cases.description: Manage several independent changes with dedicated implementers and consistent review checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Practice Structured Delivery
use_cases.description: Learn a repeatable sequence for implementation, specification review, quality review, and final validation.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Simple Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use subagent-driven development to execute this plan: [plan]. Confirm the tasks are independent. Review specifications and code quality after each task.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner execution of a short prepared plan

prompt_templates.title: Execute Selected Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute tasks [numbers] from [plan]. Give each implementer the full task and context. Stop and ask me when requirements are unclear.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused execution of part of a larger plan

prompt_templates.title: Require Tests and Reviews
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the workflow in [repository] for [plan]. Require tests and self-review. Repeat specification and quality reviews until every finding is resolved.
prompt_templates.scenario: Strict delivery with repeated quality gates

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Complete Branch
prompt_templates.prompt: Coordinate this multi-task change: [plan]. Track task status, commits, review findings, and fixes. Finish with an independent review of the complete branch.

output_examples.input: Execute the first authentication task from the prepared plan.

output_examples.input: Run the workflow and resolve every review finding.
output_examples.output: The specification reviewer found a missing requirement. The implementer corrected it, then passed specification and quality reviews.

output_examples.input: Complete all independent tasks and review the final branch.
output_examples.output: Each task passed both review stages. The final reviewer checked the combined implementation and reported it ready for branch completion.

best_practices: Provide complete task text, acceptance criteria, and architectural context to every implementer.
Resolve every specification finding before starting code quality review.
Review repository changes and approve permissions before allowing commits or destructive commands.
anti_patterns: Do not use this workflow without a clear implementation plan.
Do not run implementation subagents concurrently when their files or dependencies overlap.
Do not accept self-review as a replacement for independent specification and quality reviews.

faq.question: What type of plan works best?
faq.answer: Use a detailed implementation plan with clear acceptance criteria and tasks that can be completed mostly independently.

faq.question: Does this skill create the implementation plan?
faq.answer: No. It executes an existing plan. Create and review the plan before starting this workflow.

faq.question: Why are there two review stages?
faq.answer: Specification review checks requested behavior. Code quality review then checks maintainability, testing, and implementation quality.

faq.question: Can tasks run in parallel?
faq.answer: The documented workflow uses one implementation subagent at a time to reduce conflicting repository changes.

faq.question: Will subagents modify my repository?
faq.answer: Yes. Implementers are instructed to edit files, run tests, and create commits. Review permissions and changes before approval.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Required subagent and workflow tools must also be available.
